description: This file is a shell script used as a test suite for the 'git checkout-index' command, specifically testing the '--prefix' option and related behaviors such as handling symlinks and applying filters via '.gitattributes'. It contains setup procedures, multiple test cases with expectations, and utility function calls from an included library.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, specifying a label and a shell command sequence.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite, signaling completion.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files or output to verify correctness of test results.

methods.name: tr
methods.description: A standard Unix utility used here to translate or delete characters, used for CRLF to LF conversion in tests.
